signal: dbt Labs completed its merger with Fivetran in June 2026 to form a combined data layer for AI, and was named Snowflake's 2026 Data Integration Partner of the Year

email.subject1: a signal play for dbt Labs
email.body1:
Taylor, saw dbt Labs just closed the Fivetran merger and took Snowflake's Data Integration Partner of the Year.

A merger that size usually opens more enterprise data accounts and cross-sell motion than the team can cover before the integration settles, and that is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for dbt Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Taylor, quick follow-up for dbt Labs.

Post-merger, the combined pipeline target usually jumps faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings dbt Labs needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Taylor, last bit of proof for dbt Labs.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt Labs's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise data software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Taylor, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most right after a merger, and I know integrating two motions is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise data motion? I will tailor it to dbt Labs either way.
